pods.name: snowball-trex-pilot
pods.accounting_note: Four H100s from pod start to confirmed deletion, including setup, diagnostics, idle time, both campaigns, and replay. Upper estimate of reservation duration, not hardware-active GPU time or an invoice.

pods.name: glm-trex-pilot
pods.accounting_note: Four H100s from pod start to confirmed deletion, covering environment recovery, fixed checks, the campaign, collection and the GLM replay. Two of the four GPUs were never used: GLM is served off-pod, and the pod kept the four-GPU shape only so worker_gpus stays identical across arms. Upper estimate of reservation duration, not hardware-active GPU time.

pods.name: glm-think-pilot
pods.accounting_note: Four H100s for the reasoning-enabled GLM ablation: environment recovery, fixed checks, campaign, collection and replay. As with the matched GLM arm, two of the four GPUs were never used; the shape is kept only so worker_gpus stays identical.

retained_storage.purpose: Cached model weights, environments, and original backend outputs for recovery and follow-up work.

accounting_note: Three four-H100 pods, all released. Model inference GPU cost is not comparable across arms: Qwen served on one local GPU, Snowball on two, and both GLM arms on a shared endpoint whose cost is not ours to measure. The worker-only efficiency in docs/results.md excludes all of it.
